weather.whyMatters: Why This Matters for Your Assessment
weather.whyMattersDesc: The extreme weather patterns above directly impact structural integrity. High temperatures create expansion/contraction stress, heavy rainfall can weaken foundations and increase soil liquefaction risk, and strong winds create lateral forces that must be considered alongside seismic loads for a comprehensive safety assessment.
weather.howDataAffects: How This Data Affects Your Assessment
weather.howDataAffectsDesc: The environmental data above provides crucial context for your building's seismic risk assessment. Weather patterns affect soil conditions and material integrity over time, while seismic zone classification directly impacts the safety requirements for your structure. This information will be automatically factored into your final safety score.
